title: Application for legal aid
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Criminal Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every statutory provision cited.

parts.why: A personal letter from the suspect: name and address, then the date. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Addressed to the Director-General of the Legal Aid Council. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The salutation. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The subject heading. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
I, {{applicant}}, humbly apply for legal representation by the Legal Aid Council to assist me in conducting my defence.

I was arrested for the offence of {{offence}} on {{arrestDate}}, and I have been informed that I will be charged to court.

My annual income is {{annualIncome}}, as shown in the evidence of income attached to this letter.

Your assistance will go a long way in helping my defence. Thank you.
parts.why: States the request, the offence and arrest, and the applicant's means (with proof of income attached), which decide eligibility for legal aid. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The applicant signs. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
